Swiss Army Bench 0.0.10: projects own everything, pages for every rail icon, and a clearer Add API.

- **Projects come first:** New project asks where to save the .sab, then whether to autosave (a switch you can
  flip any time beside Save), then opens on Grids, ready for data: open a file, paste, a query, or a connection.
- **Everything belongs to the project:** its notebooks, scripts and apps, its connections and blades, its
  dashboards. Import brings them in from another project or from this computer. Passwords never go in the file:
  each computer keeps its own, and a connection that has none here says so with Set the password.
- **Every rail icon lands on a page:**
  - **Connections:** your connections as cards. Click one to see where it is used (each notebook cell and
    canvas block, a click away), its configuration, and how many times it has been called this session.
  - **Settings:** a page instead of a dialog.
  - **Notebooks, Scripts and Apps:** that kind's documents as cards.
  - No menu pops out beside the icon. A click moves the current tab; right-click, Ctrl+click or a middle click
    opens a new window.
- **Renamed:** the Sandbox is now **Visualizations**, and the Diagram is the **ERD**. The old names
  (`sab.sandbox`, the agent's `sandbox_*` commands, old links) still work for this release.
- **Add API, redone:** two clear starting choices, every field labelled, the order you think in (name, address,
  sign in, endpoints), one card per endpoint, and Try it to see the first rows before you add it.
- **Cleaner:** the tour is offered on the Start page only; Settings no longer lists the agent's activity (the
  audit log still keeps it); Export beta log says where it saved the zip.

Update from the tray (right-click, Update to 0.0.10), or:

```powershell
irm https://github.com/DylanCodyBrown/SwissArmyBench/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```
